reading_notes: The printed Council collection cover is sideways in the scan. Its whole image, both halves, and a 90-degree rotation were read visually. The address label explicitly names GROTHENDIECK A. and has a separate 5. The six session entries and the two subdivisions of the 118th session are transcribed. Printed dotted leaders are represented by periods in the table.
research_leads: Reused printed cover: MAI 1978, Recueil n°16, Conseil de l'Université; mailing label to Professor Grothendieck, Mathematics, 5.
Six dated sessions numbered116 through121, with the118th split into a and b, form a documentary table to list and count.
The separate5 on the mailing label is not explicitly a page count.
